name: ocd_textsch_s002_8v18v_v0p2_draft
description: OCD-style overdrive draft from S002-verified topology + user node connections. Supply 8-18V DC center-negative, 9V nominal test. Clip wiring confirmed from S002 image. Op-amp feedback wiring assumed. Not a verified Fulltone netlist. Do not fabricate.

supplies.name: VCC
supplies.source: 8-18V DC center-negative per C022; 9V nominal test condition

requirements.text: Two TL082 gain stages + MOSFET/diode nonlinear stage (user-reported connections)
Adjustable gain and volume (simplified in sim)

architecture.summary: Vref-biased single-supply 9V: input bias -> X1 gain -> R9/R10/R12/C7/M1/M2/D1 clip network (to Vref) -> X3 gain/filter -> tone (X4 10k pot + C11 to ground) -> HP/LP (Switch1 parallels R14/R15) -> volume -> OUT.

decisions.decision: 8-18V DC center-negative per C022; 9V nominal test condition
decisions.rationale: Project requires 8-18V range (C022); S002 confirms circuit works 9V to 18V; 9V used as nominal test point

X2 gain pot 1M per S002 retrieved text (mapping to X2 assumed); X5 volume 100k placeholder (not found in retrieved S002 text); X4/Switch1 omitted for sim

components.notes: 9V nominal test; design range 8-18V DC center-negative (C022)
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: R2 (1M) connects input cap C1 to GROUND as voltage reference, not to VREF. R6 biases op-amp to VREF.
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: biases op-amp non-inverting input to VREF (R6=470k).
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: limits current to op-amp input (R3=10k).
Drive/gain pot modeled 50% of 1M (S002 states gain pot 1M; mapping/wiring assumed).
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: bass limit in gain path (C4=100nF).
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: M1 [D&G=VREF, S=CLIP_A]. Exact part unknown; APPROX sim-only. Commenter-reported alternate wiring (M1[S=VREF,D&G=R9/R10]) does NOT match S002 image.
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: M2 [D=VREF, G&S=M2_D1_NODE]. Exact part unknown; APPROX sim-only. Commenter-reported alternate wiring (M2[D&G=VREF,S=D1]) does NOT match S002 image.
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: D1 [A=CLIP_A, K=M2_D1_NODE], 1N34A Ge per article text (C027). APPROX sim-only model, Ge variability applies.
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: TL082 section 2; non-inv input CLIP_B; wiring assumed.
Tone pot X4 (10k) modeled at 50%: upper leg TONE_TOP→TONE_W. S002-confirmed 10k pot. Wiring assumed.
Tone pot X4 (10k) modeled at 50%: lower leg TONE_W→GND. S002-confirmed 10k pot. Wiring assumed.
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: tone cap C11 to ground (C11=47nF).
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: HP/LP network resistor (R14=22k). Always in path (HP position); R15 added in parallel when Switch1 closed (LP position).
S002-schematic-image-confirmed: HP/LP network resistor (R15=33k). Added in parallel with R14 when Switch1 closed (LP position). Removing R15 models HP position (switch open).
Volume pot 100k modeled at 50% (X5 value not found in retrieved S002 text; 100k is placeholder).
Volume pot lower leg modeled at 50% (X5 value not found in retrieved S002 text; 100k is placeholder).

Tone/HP-LP values CONFIRMED from S002 schematic image: X4=10k pot (article text), C11=47nF, R14=22k, R15=33k. Switch1 wiring assumed.
